steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Good News: Unseen poetry tests skills, not knowledge. You can't revise the poems, so focus on developing analysis techniques. | Form Significance: Why did the poet choose this form? A sonnet about love connects to tradition. Free verse about trauma suggests breaking from conventions. | Top Tip: For unseen poetry, the 24-mark analysis question gets roughly 30 minutes and the 8-mark comparison gets 10-15 minutes. Always spend 5 minutes reading and annotating before writing anything — a well-planned 25-minute answer will always outperform a rushed 30-minute one.
